Lemon-Dill Salmon Skillet

  • Weeknight
  • Seafood

Ingredients

4 serving(s)

  • 2 Tbsp. olive oil
  • 4 (5- to 7-oz.) salmon fillets
  • Kosher salt
  • Freshly ground black pepper
  • 1 tsp. dried dill
  • 2 Tbsp. unsalted butter
  • 2 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
  • 1 cup green beans, trimmed
  • 2 cups baby kale
  • 1/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 oz. Pecorino, finely grated (about 1/3 cup)
  • Lemon wedges, for serving

Directions

    1. Step 1Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season salmon with salt, pepper, and dill and cook skin side down until it registers 125°, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
    2. Step 2Melt butter in the same skillet. Add garlic and green beans and cook until bright green, about 4 minutes.
    3. Step 3Stir in kale, cream, and Pecorino and simmer until the kale wilts, 2 to 3 minutes.
    4. Step 4Return salmon to skillet and serve with lemon wedges.
